Welcome! Are you ready to rethink what it really means to be productive? Most of us know that chasing productivity can feel endless — like there’s always another trick or tool we should be learning just to keep up. But what if there’s a smarter, more meaningful way forward?
In Smarter Faster Better: The Secrets of Being Productive in Life and Business, author Charles Duhigg takes us on an eye-opening journey beyond the usual advice about working harder or managing your time. Together, we’ll discover how powerful habits, mental models, and better decision-making can actually turn the tide — so you’re not just busy, but truly effective.
Through stories that span everything from high-stakes boardrooms to fast-paced emergency rooms, we’ll see how small shifts in mindset can lead to big changes in results. We’ll uncover ways to spark motivation, set goals that matter, sharpen our focus, and even help teams work together in ways that just make sense.
What makes this journey special is how research and real-world examples come together, painting a vivid picture of what it takes to thrive — whether you’re leading a team or just trying to get more from your day. And instead of strict rules, you’ll find practical strategies you can actually adapt to fit your own life, your own ambitions.
So, let’s dive in together and explore how we can all achieve more, with less stress and more clarity. Ready? Let’s get started.
